description: Shared parity vectors for the quote expiry rule (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-03-quote-expiration-design.md §2.4): expired iff validUntil is present and today(now, zone) > validUntil, where zone is timeZone when the runtime resolves it, else Etc/GMT+12 (anywhere on Earth). A null timeZone also uses Etc/GMT+12. 'now' is always second-precision UTC with a Z suffix. Loaded by native/QuoteExpiryTests and backend-workers/tests/estimateExpiry.test.cjs.

vectors.name: phoenix 23:30 local on the date is still valid
phoenix 23:59:59 local on the date is still valid
phoenix local midnight after the date is expired
new york after the DST end is not expired at the EDT midnight
new york 23:59:59 EST on the DST-end date is still valid
new york EST midnight after the DST-end date is expired
auckland 23:59:59 NZDT on the date is still valid
auckland is expired while the UTC date is still the date
unknown zone is not expired at the phoenix midnight
unknown zone uses anywhere on Earth and is valid until 11:59:59 UTC next day
unknown zone uses anywhere on Earth and is expired at 12:00 UTC next day
null zone uses anywhere on Earth and is still valid
null zone uses anywhere on Earth and is expired
